name: Lucky Dragon Hibachi
facts: Lucky Dragon Hibachi is in Compton, California.
Hours: Mon–Thu 11:00a–9:00p, Fri–Sat 11:00a–10:00p, Sun 12:00p–8:00p.
Hibachi Catch is a free 30-second catching game.
Catch food for +10 each, Gold Star +50. Flame, candy and ice cost -20.
Dragon fire costs -30. Three dragon hits end your run.
650+ points in one run gets 15% off your next meal and a spot on the weekly board.
Weekly board runs Monday through Sunday close and resets every Monday.
1st place on the weekly board wins 50% off their next meal. 2nd place wins 20% off.
The Daily Spin is free: one spin per member per day.
Rewards: 250 pts = Free extra Yum-Yum, 500 = Free fried rice, 800 = Free hibachi plate, 1300 = Dinner for two.
Joining offer: Free Extra Yum-Yum + 10% off your next plate.
Referral gift: Free fried rice.
Spin prizes are good for 3 days at the Compton location, one reward per visit.
No purchase is necessary to play, spin or win.
Players must be 13 or older. Under 18 needs a parent's or guardian's permission.
One free member account per person and per phone.
Your info is used only for your rewards account and is never sold.
Instagram: @luckydragon360.
The app has a language menu with 12 languages.

qa.q: What are your hours?
qa.a: Mon–Thu 11:00a–9:00p, Fri–Sat 11:00a–10:00p, and Sun 12:00p–8:00p.

qa.q: What time do you open today?
qa.a: Mon–Sat we open at 11:00a, and on Sunday at 12:00p. Check the day-by-day hours in the app's Hours section.

qa.q: What time do you close?
qa.a: Mon–Thu 9:00p, Fri–Sat 10:00p, Sun 8:00p.

qa.q: Are you open on Sunday?
qa.a: Yes, Sundays are 12:00p–8:00p.

qa.q: Are you open on weekends?
qa.a: Yes. Fri–Sat 11:00a–10:00p and Sun 12:00p–8:00p.

qa.q: Are you open on holidays?
qa.a: I don't have holiday hours. Please call 562-564-9200 and ask staff.

qa.q: Where are you located?
qa.a: We're in Compton, California. The app shows the exact street address once it's added. Tap Directions or Open in Google Maps to find us.

qa.q: What's the street address?
qa.a: I don't have the full street address here. Tap Directions in the app to open Google Maps, or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: How do I get directions?
qa.a: Tap the Directions button in the app. It opens Lucky Dragon Hibachi, Compton CA in Google Maps.

qa.q: Where do I park?
qa.a: I don't have parking details. Please ask staff or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: What's your phone number?
qa.a: Call us at 562-564-9200. There's a Call to order button in the app.

qa.q: Can I order by phone?
qa.a: Yes. Tap the Call to order button in the app, or dial 562-564-9200.

qa.q: How do I order?
qa.a: You can call 562-564-9200, or build a plate in the app with Build your plate and place the order. Ask staff if you need help.

qa.q: Can I order from my table with a QR code?
qa.a: I don't have details on table ordering. Ask staff, or use the Build your plate feature in the app.

qa.q: Do you do delivery?
qa.a: I don't have delivery info. Please call 562-564-9200 and ask.

qa.q: Do you do takeout?
qa.a: You can call 562-564-9200 to order. For pickup details, ask staff.

qa.q: Can I pay in the app?
qa.a: I don't have payment details. Please ask staff at the counter or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: What's on the menu?
qa.a: Hibachi Grill: Chicken, Steak, Shrimp, Chicken + Shrimp Combo, and Premium Lobster. Sides & Extras: Fried Rice, Noodles, and Extra Yum-Yum.

qa.q: How much is the Hibachi Chicken?
qa.a: $12.95, as shown in the app. It comes with grilled chicken, fried rice, veggies and house yum-yum.

qa.q: How much is the Hibachi Steak?
qa.a: $15.95, as shown in the app. It's sirloin with fried rice, veggies and double yum-yum.

qa.q: How much is the Hibachi Shrimp?
qa.a: $14.95, as shown in the app. It's jumbo shrimp with fried rice and veggies.

qa.q: What is the Chicken + Shrimp Combo?
qa.a: It's $16.95 in the app, and it's the combo from the review video.

qa.q: How much is the lobster?
qa.a: Premium Lobster is market price (MP). It's grilled hibachi style and you can add it to any meal.

qa.q: How much is the fried rice?
qa.a: Fried Rice (solo) is $6.50. It's wok-fired with egg and scallion.

qa.q: How much are the noodles?
qa.a: Noodles are $6.95. They're garlic butter hibachi noodles.

qa.q: How much is extra Yum-Yum sauce?
qa.a: Extra Yum-Yum is $1.00.

qa.q: Can I build my own plate?
qa.a: Yes. Use Build your plate in the app to pick a base, proteins and extras, watch the price add up, then place your order.

qa.q: What bases can I pick when building a plate?
qa.a: Fried rice ($6.50), Chow mein ($6.95), or Half & half ($7.50).

qa.q: What proteins can I add to a plate?
qa.a: Chicken $6.45, Steak $9.45, Shrimp $8.45 (up to 2 each), plus Salmon $9.95 and Scallops $10.95 (1 each).

qa.q: What extras can I add?
qa.a: Hibachi veggies are free (1) and Yum-yum is $1 each (up to 2).

qa.q: Do you have vegetarian options?
qa.a: The app lists hibachi veggies and fried rice, but I don't have dietary details. Please ask staff.

qa.q: Do you have allergy information?
qa.a: I don't have allergy info. Please tell staff about any allergies before you order, or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: Do you have drinks?
qa.a: Drinks show up in the game, but the menu in the app doesn't list any. Ask staff what's available.

qa.q: Are there any specials right now?
qa.a: I don't see any specials running in the app right now. Ask staff or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: Is there a happy hour?
qa.a: I don't have a happy hour listed. Ask staff or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: How do I sign up or join rewards?
qa.a: Make a free member account with your name, phone number and email. The live app confirms your phone with a text code.

qa.q: Is joining free?
qa.a: Yes, member accounts are free. No purchase is needed.

qa.q: What do I get for joining?
qa.a: The app shows a joining offer of Free Extra Yum-Yum plus 10% off your next plate.

qa.q: Do I need an account to play the game?
qa.a: No. Hibachi Catch is free to play with no account. You only need a free account to save your score or claim a prize.

qa.q: Who can join?
qa.a: Legal U.S. residents who are 13 or older. Players under 18 need a parent's or guardian's permission.

qa.q: Can kids play?
qa.a: Players 13 and older can, and anyone under 18 needs a parent's or guardian's permission.

qa.q: Can I have more than one account?
qa.a: No. It's one account per person and per phone. Extra accounts can get your scores disqualified.

qa.q: Why does it need my phone number?
qa.a: Your account is tied to the phone it was made on, and the live app confirms your number with a text code.

qa.q: How do reward points work?
qa.a: Points from the daily spin and from purchases go into your Lucky Dragon Hibachi Rewards account. You trade them for the rewards listed in the app.

qa.q: How many points do I get per dollar?
qa.a: I don't have a points-per-dollar number. Ask staff or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: How many points do I get per visit?
qa.a: I don't have a per-visit number. Ask staff or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: What can I get with my points?
qa.a: 250 pts = Free extra Yum-Yum. 500 pts = Free fried rice. 800 pts = Free hibachi plate. 1300 pts = Dinner for two.

qa.q: How many points for a free hibachi plate?
qa.a: 800 points.

qa.q: How many points for dinner for two?
qa.a: 1300 points.

qa.q: How many points for free fried rice?
qa.a: 500 points.

qa.q: How many points for free Yum-Yum?
qa.a: 250 points for a free extra Yum-Yum.

qa.q: How do I redeem a reward?
qa.a: Pick the reward in the app once you have enough points. Winners may be asked to show the code on their phone and a matching account at the counter.

qa.q: Do points expire?
qa.a: I don't have an expiration policy. Ask staff. Points have no cash value.

qa.q: Are there levels or tiers?
qa.a: I don't have level details for Lucky Dragon. Ask staff or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: Is there a birthday reward?
qa.a: I don't have birthday club details. Ask staff or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: How do referrals work?
qa.a: The app lists a referral gift of Free fried rice. For the exact steps, ask staff.

qa.q: Is there a bonus for being nearby or showing up?
qa.a: The app offers a nearby note: show it at the counter for double stars on today's order. Ask staff if it's running today.

qa.q: What is the Daily Spin?
qa.a: It's a free wheel you can spin once a day. Every slice wins something, like points, discounts or free extras.

qa.q: How often can I spin?
qa.a: Once per member per day, by Los Angeles time.

qa.q: Does the spin cost anything?
qa.a: No. It's always free and never costs tokens. You can't buy spins or earn them by buying food.

qa.q: What can I win on the Daily Spin?
qa.a: +50 points (30%), +100 points (20%), +75 points (15%), $2 off a hibachi plate (15%), free extra Yum-Yum (8%), free side of fried rice (7%), or 10% off your order (5%).

qa.q: How long do spin prizes last?
qa.a: Food prizes and discounts are good for 3 days at the Compton location. It's one reward per visit and they can't be combined with other rewards.

qa.q: Can I trade a spin prize for cash?
qa.a: No. Prizes have no cash value and can't be transferred.

qa.q: What is Hibachi Catch?
qa.a: It's a free 30-second game. Slide your tray to catch hibachi food, dodge flames, candy and ice, and escape the Lucky Dragon's fire.

qa.q: How do I play Hibachi Catch?
qa.a: Tap to start, then slide your finger across the game to move the tray. Catch the food and dodge what doesn't belong. The round lasts 30 seconds.

qa.q: What do I catch for points?
qa.a: Chicken, steak, shrimp, lobster, veggies, chow mein, fried rice and drinks are +10 each. The Gold Star is +50.

qa.q: What should I dodge?
qa.a: Flames, candy and ice cost -20 each and reset your streak. Dragon fire costs -30 and also resets your streak.

qa.q: How does the streak bonus work?
qa.a: Catch food in a row without a miss to build a streak. You get +2 extra per catch in a row, up to +10. At a streak of 5 or more that's +20 per catch.

qa.q: What does the dragon do?
qa.a: It locks onto your tray with a dashed red line, then breathes fire. Move out of the way! Each hit is -30 points.

qa.q: How many dragon hits end the game?
qa.a: Three. Your rice gets darker with each hit, and on the third the food is burnt and the run is over.

qa.q: How often can I play Hibachi Catch?
qa.a: As often as you like. It's free for anyone, with no account needed.

qa.q: Is there a score prize?
qa.a: Yes. One run of 650 points or more earns 15% off your next meal and a spot on the weekly board.

qa.q: How does the weekly leaderboard work?
qa.a: The highest score from Monday through Sunday close wins. Ties go to the score posted first, and the board resets every Monday.

qa.q: What do the weekly winners get?
qa.a: 1st place wins 50% off their next meal and 2nd place wins 20% off.

qa.q: When does the weekly board reset?
qa.a: Every Monday, and a new week of winners starts.

qa.q: When are weekly prizes decided?
qa.a: At the Sunday close of the Monday–Sunday week. Ask staff how and when winners are contacted.

qa.q: How do I save my score or claim a prize?
qa.a: After a run, make a free member account (name, phone, email). Then your score and prize get saved.

qa.q: Do I have to buy something to win?
qa.a: No. No purchase is necessary to play, spin or win, and buying doesn't improve your chances.

qa.q: Is Hibachi Catch luck or skill?
qa.a: It's a game of skill. Prizes depend only on your score and where you rank on the weekly board.

qa.q: What counts as cheating?
qa.a: Scores made with cheats, scripts, bots or multiple accounts are disqualified.

qa.q: What is the paper lantern in the game?
qa.a: A paper lantern floats down once per run. Catch it on your tray for a +300 bonus, and you can watch Antidote The Foodie's review afterward.

qa.q: Why did a video play during my game?
qa.a: After about 90 seconds of total play, the next new run opens with a short halftime clip from Antidote The Foodie's review of Lucky Dragon. You can skip it.

qa.q: Are there game tokens?
qa.a: Tokens are not turned on right now, so Hibachi Catch is free to play. If that changes, the app will say so.

qa.q: Can I play with a game controller?
qa.a: Yes. Pair a controller and press a button, then use the stick or D-pad to slide the tray.

qa.q: Can I play full screen or lock the screen?
qa.a: Yes. The game has a Full screen button and a Lock button so the page doesn't scroll while you play.

qa.q: How do I add the app to my phone's home screen?
qa.a: Use the Add to Home Screen link in the app footer. On iPhone, tap Share then Add to Home Screen. On Android, use the browser menu then Install or Add to Home screen.

qa.q: What languages does the app support?
qa.a: English, Spanish, Chinese (simplified and traditional), Korean, Tagalog, Vietnamese, Armenian, Persian, Japanese, Thai and Russian. Tap the 🌐 button to switch.

qa.q: How do I change the language?
qa.a: Tap the 🌐 language button at the top right and pick your language. Restaurant and game names stay in English.

qa.q: Can I leave a Google review?
qa.a: Yes, there's a button for writing a Google review. Honest reviews only, and no points or prizes are given for reviews.

qa.q: Where can I see your Instagram?
qa.a: We're @luckydragon360. The app shows our latest posts and reels.

qa.q: Is my information safe?
qa.a: Your info is used only for your rewards account and is never sold. Opt-in texts and emails can be stopped anytime by replying STOP or unsubscribing.

qa.q: How do I stop texts?
qa.a: Reply STOP to any text or unsubscribe from any email.

qa.q: Can employees win prizes?
qa.a: Employees and their household members can play but can't win prizes.

qa.q: Who can I ask for help?
qa.a: Call 562-564-9200 or ask a team member at the restaurant.

qa.q: Where can I read the official rules?
qa.a: Tap Game & daily spin official rules at the bottom of the app.
